name: Circuit of The Americas - Grand Prix
author: Reboot Team
notes: Circuit of The Americas is the premier destination for world-class motorsports and entertainment in the United States. Set in the rolling hills just outside downtown Austin, Circuit of The Americas has hosted the biggest names in racing since 2012. At its heart is a 3.41-mile racetrack that was designed to challenge the world's most exacting competitors while providing a thrilling spectacle for audiences.
